text: French-language World Bank documents on teacher training for Morocco or Tunisia (catalog metadata search; few records are about teacher training specifically):

- Composante Learning and Evaluation du Pré-Test Teaching at the Right Level (TaRL): Résultats de l'Évaluation de Processus (Report 209429, 2023-12-31): process evaluation of the TaRL pre-test run by the Fondation Sanady for the INDH, covering the training of teachers and mentors. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099040326141039051

- Quels Enseignements Pouvons-Nous Tirer de l'Expansion de l'Enseignement Préscolaire au Maroc ? (Working Paper 207313, Early Learning Partnership series, 2025-12-17): foundations played a key role in recruiting and training preschool teachers. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099054412172524939
- Related TaRL reports: Rapport de la Phase de Pré-Test de TaRL (209427, 2026-04-06) and Évaluation de l'Impact des Programmes Éducatifs TaRL et Sanady Classique au Maroc (209425, 2024-12-31).
- Project document: Maroc - Projet de Programme d'Appui au Secteur de l'Éducation (PAD3157, 2019-05-30), the appraisal document of the education sector support program.

Tunisia: no recent French-language report on teacher training; older records are the education quality improvement program (PAQSET) appraisal documents (2000, 2004) and its completion report (ICR, 2007).
Many hits for 'enseignants' are false matches on 'enseignements' (lessons learned), e.g. youth employment, urban resilience and COVID-19 household surveys; they are not teacher-training reports.

right_sources: Applies the French language filter and covers both Morocco and Tunisia; returns at least one of the TaRL reports (209429 or 209427) or the preschool working paper (207313).
grounded: Every listed record exists with the stated title, country, language and date.
complete: Covers both countries (saying if Tunisia has little) and gives title, date and link per record.
scoped: Says the matches come from a metadata search and does not present 'enseignements' (lessons) records as teacher-training reports.

notes: A thin-result case: honest coverage and filtering matter more than length.
